title: Boba Tea Adventure
description: Mix chewy pearls, creamy milk tea, and colorful toppings across fast-paced beverage orders—serve eager customers and unlock trendy new boba recipes.
controls: Tap ingredients and cup stations to craft customer orders quickly and clear each lively shop stage.

zh-CN.title: 奶茶大冒险
zh-CN.description: 超治愈爆款奶茶店闯关冒险：调配波霸珍珠、芝士奶盖与缤纷果茶，手速爆表服务排队顾客解锁全套网红爆款配方！
zh-CN.controls: 点击选择茶底、珍珠与配料调制顾客指定的奶茶饮品，快速出餐完成关卡目标。
